# JoinOrder Q4c — Canonical JoinOrder 4c


> [JoinOrder](../../join-order.md) benchmark · [all JoinOrder queries](index.md)

Canonical JoinOrder SQL query 4c; generated DataFrame translation

## Representative SQL

Rendered in the benchmark's native SQL with default parameters (no dialect translation available).

```sql
SELECT MIN(mi_idx.info) AS rating,
       MIN(t.title) AS movie_title
FROM info_type AS it,
     keyword AS k,
     movie_info_idx AS mi_idx,
     movie_keyword AS mk,
     title AS t
WHERE it.info ='rating'
  AND k.keyword LIKE '%sequel%'
  AND mi_idx.info > '2.0'
  AND t.production_year > 1990
  AND t.id = mi_idx.movie_id
  AND t.id = mk.movie_id
  AND mk.movie_id = mi_idx.movie_id
  AND k.id = mk.keyword_id
  AND it.id = mi_idx.info_type_id;
```
